title: The recovered B image has a concrete identity.
caption: The image summary identifies the imported PE and its PackClientLauncher PDB name. The recorded SHA-256 identifies recovered image B.
source: Ghidra program information for recovered image B.

title: The worker opens an existing endpoint.
caption: 1. CreateFileW receives the supplied endpoint, read/write access and disposition 3 (OPEN_EXISTING). 2. The READY header uses magic 0x50435231 and type 1. The endpoint namespace and external peer are not recovered.
source: Ghidra decompilation of the worker endpoint-open and READY path.

title: The recapture branch constructs a type-2 response.
caption: The literal type 2 and the send-helper call are visible in the recovered recapture path. The field semantics and BGRX payload layout come from the linked static dataflow analysis. This is reconstructed code, not a captured live framebuffer.
source: Ghidra disassembly of the recapture response in image B.

title: Authentication gates decryption.
caption: 1. Compute the envelope MAC. 2. Compare the received tag. 3. Enter the decrypt helper only after the comparison succeeds. Helper roles are established in the transport analysis; the screenshot shows their control-flow order.
source: Ghidra decompilation of the authenticated receive path in image B.

title: The active-session path retries a token-based launch.
caption: The recovered call uses CreateProcessAsUserW with flags 0x09000400. The loop sleeps for 1,000 ms after failure and stops after at most 0x1E attempts. This is the active-session helper, not proof of the original chain's elevation API.
source: Ghidra decompilation of the active-session spawn loop in image B.

title: One parent creates two siblings.
caption: Process Monitor records parent PID 2116 creating svchost PID 3696 and schtasks PID 4600; schtasks then creates conhost PID 8248. SUCCESS is the Process Create result, not the child's exit code.
source: Process Monitor process-creation rows from the PID 3696 evidence set.

title: NvSvc combines an at-logon trigger with a ProgramData action.
caption: Task Scheduler shows NvSvc's enabled at-logon trigger, ProgramData action and configured principal. Highest available privileges for this user do not establish SYSTEM execution.
source: Task Scheduler action, trigger and principal settings for NvSvc.

title: The surviving surrogate has a bare command line.
caption: 1. Bare SysWOW64 svchost command line. 2. Parent 2116 has exited. 3. The process is x86. The Downloads\PackClient current directory supplies additional context. These properties support an anomalous surrogate, without identifying an injection subtype.
source: Process Explorer properties for PID 3696.

title: Connection attempts from svchost.exe, PID 3696.
caption: Process Explorer shows two SYN_SENT attempts to 154.36.188.201:443, from local ports 54581 and 50275.
source: Process Explorer TCP/IP views associated with PID 3696.

title: Private executable allocation in svchost.exe, PID 5812.
caption: VMMap shows a 408 KiB Execute/Read allocation at 0x002E0000. Corresponding dump analysis identifies its contents as the transformed A/B package.
source: VMMap allocation views from the PID 5812 evidence set.

title: The debugger is stopped before deletion.
caption: This is the PID 8148 pre-call stop. EAX at this point is not DeleteObject's return value. The image supplies call-site context; it does not prove successful deletion or establish the cause of the later PID 8040 failure.
source: Debugger breakpoint capture from the PID 8148 attempt.

title: The final worker attempt failed before READY.
caption: The saved record shows an access violation at RVA 0xA567 with EDI=0x13C, followed by a zero-byte READY timeout. The attempt included manual debugger changes, so the crash does not establish a failure in unmodified execution or a causal use-after-free diagnosis.
source: Debugger and peer-output captures from the PID 8040 attempt.

title: The installed pair uses a signed host and a separate companion DLL.
caption: Explorer shows Tax_Notice_23665.exe beside nvdaHelperRemote.dll under C:\ProgramData\NVIDIA Corporation\NvSvc. A separate properties view lists an embedded NV Access Limited signature for the host. The signature belongs to the host; this view does not authenticate the companion DLL.
source: Explorer directory listing and host Digital Signatures properties, captured separately.

title: The plaintext must pass digest verification, cache save and cache reload.
caption: The recovered transfer body checks the plaintext digest, requires Save to succeed, and immediately requires TryLoad to return a nonempty vector. The visible failure branches are SHA256 mismatch, disk_cache_save_failed and disk_cache_reload_failed. This is statically reconstructed control flow, not evidence of successful delivery.
source: Ghidra decompilation of image B’s PLK1 acceptance and cache-return path.

title: A historical Triage Launcher flow reaches PLK1.
caption: Wireshark displays PLH1, PLC1, PLA1 and PLK1 on the filtered historical flow. The selected PLK1 header declares wire version 2, LZ4, 669,717 transferred bytes, 985,088 original bytes and the expected Core plaintext SHA-256.
source: Filtered derivative of Triage 260715-wd77daas7l/behavioral1, opened with the repository Wireshark dissector; this is not a separate capture.

title: Full-EXE execution persists the Tax Notice host.
caption: The process view records NvSvc task creation with the ProgramData Tax_Notice_23665.exe action, matching the intended signed-host/carrier chain.
source: Triage 260908-zwr5naybjb behavioral1 process report.

title: Direct-DLL execution persists a copied rundll32 host.
caption: The direct rundll32 invocation causes NvSvc to target a copied rundll32.exe without the DLL argument. That action cannot replay the original entry point and is treated as a sandbox-context artifact, not a second variant.
source: Triage 260908-zwr5naybjb behavioral2 process report.

title: The signed host calls the carrier initializer.
caption: At host RVA 0x1004, the signed Tax Notice executable directly calls the imported nvdaHelperRemote.dll injection_initialize entry, closing the previously unresolved export-selection boundary.
source: Ghidra disassembly and decompilation of Tax_Notice_23665.exe.

title: Core resolves and validates the modern plugin ABI.
caption: The recovered Core resolves PackPlugin_GetAbiVersion and PackPlugin_GetFeatureId before accepting feature-specific host bindings. A separate legacy path resolves Main.
source: Ghidra decompilation of reconstructed PackClientCore.dll function 0x10016231.

title: Core serializes its built-in preview as PV10.
caption: The Core serializer emits the PV10 marker in the built-in screenshot-preview path. Packet reconstruction finds 15 matching type-18 JPEG frames; no bridge from the separate Launcher 1RCP endpoint is established.
source: Ghidra disassembly and decompilation of reconstructed PackClientCore.dll RVA 0x236D0.
